actionDesc.dns_record_list: List DNS records of a domain
actionDesc.dns_record_get: Read one DNS record by its ID
actionDesc.dns_record_update: Update the value of a DNS record
actionDesc.dns_record_set_status: Enable or pause a DNS record
actionDesc.dns_record_batch: Write multiple DNS records in one call (irreversible)
actionDesc.dns_domain_list: List domains visible in the current scope
actionDesc.tencenteo_origin_group_list: List origin groups of an EdgeOne site
actionDesc.tencenteo_origin_group_plan: Computes the diff only, no upstream write (dry run): shows which origin servers would be removed
actionDesc.tencenteo_origin_group_replace: Replaces all origin servers in the group with this value (writes upstream, irreversible); only shrinks, never grows
actionDesc.virtual_origin_group_plan_sync: Compute the address sync diff (dry run)
actionDesc.virtual_origin_group_sync: Sync addresses into the virtual origin group (writes upstream)
actionDesc.http_outbound_fetch: Perform one outbound HTTPS request subject to the allowlist
actionDesc.notify_channel_send: Send a message through configured channels

paramHint.diff_digest: Produced by the preceding plan step. Set "Store result in variable" there, then reference that variable here.
paramHint.target: Full declaration of the target origin servers, in the format the origin group expects.
paramHint.record_id: Once a domain is chosen, its DNS records are listed here — just pick one.
paramHint.collapse: Required. Writing an origin group is a whole-group replace: it only shrinks, never grows. The action will not run unless this is checked.
paramHint.acknowledge_referenced: If the group is still referenced by domains, replacing it immediately changes their origin behaviour. Check this only after reviewing the impact.
paramHint.acknowledge_data_loss: Removed origin servers may carry object-storage private parameters that cannot be rebuilt. Check this only if losing them is acceptable.
